prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Phoenix for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist—the right choice depends on your case, budget, location, and whether you prefer braces or Invisalign. A good starting point is to compare **board-certified orthodontists** and get two or three consultations.

A few Phoenix options to consider:

- **Dunn Orthodontics** — Drs. Matthew and Courtney Dunn are board-certified and offer braces, clear braces, and Invisalign, with several Phoenix-area locations.
- **Serrano Orthodontics** — Drs. Paul and Andrew Serrano are board-certified and offer braces and Invisalign; their Phoenix office is on East Missouri Avenue.
- **Dr. John C. Budd** — Board-certified, with Phoenix offices on East Bell Road and North 32nd Street.
- **Dr. Spencer Mecham** — Board-certified, with an office in south Phoenix.

At consultations, ask who will supervise your treatment, what option they recommend and why, the full cost (including retainers and refinements), and how emergencies or missed appointments are handled. You can also verify credentials through the American Association of Orthodontists’ “Find an Orthodontist” directory.
